assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional (official_boundary=false, provisional_rough precision) derived from the public announcement text, area constraints and road names; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics are calculated on provisional geometry; official polygon release requires full regeneration and recalculation of layers, metrics, figures and drawings.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, land ownership, rail alignments, river blue lines and heritage protection ranges are represented only as low-confidence analysis helpers or conceptual blocks; they need official survey verification.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish and constraint statements are conceptual and must not be treated as statutory conclusions.

assumptions.statement: The low-speed unmanned delivery pilot zone, delivery routes and shuttle lines are conceptual design suggestions. Pilot boundaries, speed limits, avoidance rules and operational responsibility must be reviewed by transport, safety, operations and public-participation teams, and pilots are retractable.
assumptions.impact: Delivery route lengths and pilot areas are design-level metrics, not approved operations or engineering feasibility conclusions.

assumptions.statement: AI health navigation and AI education scenarios provide only public service navigation and science communication. Health content does not constitute medical advice; content requires medical, legal, data-security and education professional review.
assumptions.impact: Scenario service boundaries are design commitments, not operating guarantees; data minimization and human review remain mandatory.

assumptions.statement: Event participation, scenario usage, delivery volumes, talent density and international communication performance indicators require future operation data; no operational performance is claimed today.
assumptions.impact: Performance indicators remain monitoring targets; they are not evidence of implemented activities.

assumptions.statement: Rail corridor and river blue line references in constraints.geojson are schematic only, marked analysis_helper with low confidence; official alignment data was not publicly available.
assumptions.impact: Station-post and blue-green integration concepts may shift once official alignments are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, test scenarios and event operations are conceptual design suggestions subject to data-minimization, human-review and authorization rules; they are not approved deployments.
assumptions.impact: Scenario privacy boundaries and review mechanisms are design commitments, not operating guarantees.
